meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters—especially Delhi/North India—mein **dry skin ke liye thick, barrier-supporting moisturizer** best rahega. Glycerin, ceramides, panthenol aur/or hyaluronic acid jaise ingredients useful hain. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Meri top picks

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹356*

### [Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance Ultra Hydrating Lotion]()
*₹208*

### [Bioderma Atoderm Creme Ultra-Nourishing Cream]()
*₹629*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹266*

**🥇 Best overall: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream**  
Very dry skin ke liye meri first choice. Ceramides + hydrating ingredients ki wajah se winter mein barrier support ke liye achha option.

**💰 Best value: Cetaphil DAM Daily Advance**  
Agar budget reasonable rakhna hai, ye excellent everyday option hai. Cetaphil bhi dry winter skin ke liye glycerin, panthenol aur shea butter jaise moisturizing ingredients recommend karta hai. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skincare-tips/skin-concern/how-to-take-care-of-dry-skin-in-winter.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🧴 Bahut zyada dry/flaky skin: Bioderma Atoderm**  
Thoda richer feel chahiye toh consider karo.

**🇮🇳 Budget-friendly: Re'equil Ceramide & HA**  
Ceramide-based option, especially agar face par winter dryness hoti hai.

**Simple rule:** moisturizer **face wash ke turant baad slightly damp skin par** lagao, aur subah sunscreen bhi. Winter mein fragrance-free formula sensitive/dry skin ke liye safer choice ho sakta hai. [www.cetaphil.in](https://www.cetaphil.in/skin-type/dry-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum **apna budget (₹300/₹500/₹1000) aur skin type (dry + acne-prone ya simply dry)** bata do, main **sirf 2 best options** shortlist kar dunga.
